description: PHYSICALITY - HARD CONTACT COSTS MORE, INCLUDING CARDS. READ THE CARD PARAGRAPH BEFORE APPLYING. WHAT CHANGES: two of the three terms the referee's contact scorer (match::ai::Judge 0x143d88fe0) adds up for every collision. (1) The relative-speed term's ceiling goes 35 -> 40 points. (2) The distance-from-the-ball ramp on one gated contact sub-kind goes 20 -> 25 points. Maximum added score is +10, and only on contacts that already score near the top. THE CARD CONSEQUENCE - THIS IS WHAT THE EARLIER DRAFT OF THIS PACK GOT WRONG, and it was the single worst claim in the set. The three scorer terms are summed as BYTES into one value (0x143d891cd 'add bl,al'; 0x143d891d9 'add al,bl'; 0x143d891e0 'movzx eax,al') and that byte is passed to the level function 0x143d861f0, which tests it against the foul threshold (40 outside the box, 60 inside), then against 80 for a yellow and 110 for a red - all off the SAME number. Leaving the card lines alone while raising the score is exactly the mechanism that produces more cards. Concretely, with this pack: a contact that gains the full +10 and stocks anywhere in 70-79 becomes a YELLOW, and one stocking in 100-109 becomes a RED (a contact gaining only d points crosses if it stocks in [80-d, 79] or [110-d, 109]). There is no way to raise the score without this happening. If what you want is more free kicks at the same card count, use phys-whistle-threshold.json instead - that lowers the foul bar and provably leaves 80 and 110 where they are. WHAT EDIT 1 ACTUALLY MEASURES - also corrected. The earlier draft called this the 'late challenge' lever on the grounds that a late challenge is by construction the one arriving fast. That is wrong. The quantity is the magnitude of the VELOCITY DIFFERENCE between the two players: 0x143d86b1b-0x143d86b4f fetch both velocity vectors, subtract them componentwise, square, sum and sqrtf, then scale by fps*3.6 into km/h. Two men sprinting the same way at the same speed score ZERO from this term, and a defender chasing at 30 km/h who clips a man running at 25 km/h scores 4 points stock, 5 with this pack. The chase-down recovery tackle - the definitive late tackle in football terms - gains almost nothing here. What this term prices is head-on contact and running into a stationary or slow player. Judge the pack on that, not on the old description. WHO IT AFFECTS: everyone. The Judge sees two player slots and never asks who is human; you will concede as well as win. EVIDENCE: edit 1 is DEMONSTRATED (level a) - emulating the game's own term (0x143d86ab0 under Unicorn on the pristine image, velocity getter and fps stubbed) gives relative km/h -> points, stock vs patched: 5 -> 4/5, 10 -> 12/13, 15 -> 19/22, 20 -> 27/31, saturating 35/40 above 25 km/h, identical at 27, 54 and 120 fps. Edit 2 is READ FROM DISASSEMBLY (level b) - I disassembled 0x143d86884-0x143d868fe this pass: a sub-kind gate ('cmp byte [rbx+0x54], 3 / jne skip'), then the 2D distance between the action's stored position and a fetched position, ramped 0 at <=2 m to 1 at >=3 m, multiplied by the constant and added into the score. Direction certain. INFERRED ONLY (level c): that sub-kind 3 is the sliding tackle. If that is wrong, edit 2 simply prices a different single animation family - it does nothing else. SCORE-WRAP CHECK: the sum is 8-bit. Bounding the terms (base <=35+12, geometry bonus <=30, speed <=40 patched, slid-in <=25 patched), and noting the sub-kind-3 gate at 0x143d86884 means the slid-in term and the 35-base cannot co-occur, the patched worst case stays well under 256. Do not stack further score-inflating edits on top. DO NOT RUN THIS WITH phys-whistle-threshold OR phys-tackle-commit ON A FIRST OUTING. All three raise the foul count by different routes and you will not know which one you are feeling. phys-tackle-commit compounds with this one specifically: it creates more contacts AND its shorter lockout feeds the repeat-offender escalation at 0x143d87511-0x143d87543, which adds count/3 to the score inside a 45-unit window before the level is computed. STRONGER VERSION: 45 and 30, the values this pack originally shipped with - re-aim 0x143d86bcd to cell 0x145b1d910 = 45.0 (bytes F30F593D3B6DD901) and 0x143d868fe to cell 0x145a8dd80 = 30.0 (bytes F30F593D7A74D001). That doubles the card shift: stock 60-79 becomes yellow and stock 90-109 becomes red. Only go there after watching the default for a full match. REVERT: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/phys-reckless-contact.json

patches.name: relative-speed term ceiling 35 -> 40 points
patches.note: mulss xmm7, [0x145c8d614 = 35.0] re-aimed to [0x145d58ec8 = 40.0]. xmm7 is the 0..1 ramp over 2..25 km/h of |vA - vB| (built at 0x143d86b95-0x143d86bc1), truncated into the score byte. Target cell .tls$, writers=0, ptr_refs=0.

patches.name: distance-from-ball ramp on contact sub-kind 3, 20 -> 25 points
patches.note: mulss xmm7, [0x145a8aa44 = 20.0] re-aimed to [0x145da7de0 = 25.0]. xmm7 is the 0..1 ramp over 2..3 m (clamps at 0x143d868d7 and 0x143d868e4), zeroed at 0x143d86796 on every entry path; the whole block is gated on 'cmp byte [rbx+0x54], 3' at 0x143d86884. Zero at <=2 m, so a challenge made at the ball is unaffected. Target cell .tls$, writers=0, ptr_refs=0.
